name: Schengen Visitor Visa / Visa-Free Entry

qualifying_event.description: Austria is a Schengen member. Nationals of visa-exempt countries may enter visa-free for short stays; others must obtain a Schengen (Type C) visa from an Austrian consulate before travel.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Passport; travel purpose documentation; proof of funds; return travel evidence; travel/health insurance.

requirements.blocker_text: Short-stay Schengen visa/visa-free entry permits up to 90 days within any 180-day period across the whole Schengen area, not just Austria.
Travel medical insurance covering at least EUR 30,000 is required for visa applicants (standard Schengen requirement).

evidence_required.document: Proof of sufficient funds and return travel

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days in any 180-day period

sources.title: migration.gv.at -- Types of immigration overview: short-stay Schengen visa/visa-free entry (up to 90/180 days), general Schengen entry conditions

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Austria). Standard Schengen short-stay entry -- same 90/180 rule and general conditions as every other Schengen member built in this dataset. No route to any further status.
